why: 牛 cow + 肉 meat + 面 noodles: literally 'cow-meat noodles'.
鸡 chicken + 蛋 egg + 面 noodles: 'chicken-egg noodles'.
炸 fry + 酱 sauce + 面 noodles. 炸 has 火 fire on the left.
酸 sour + 辣 spicy + 粉 starch noodles. A Chengdu street classic.
饣 on the left means food.
包 = to wrap: filling wrapped in dough. Same 包 as in 打包.
Sounds like 'cola' and means 'can be happy'.
艹 grass on top, 木 tree at the bottom, a person 人 in between: picking leaves.
石 stone on the left: the first bowls were stone.
The all-purpose measure word. If unsure, 个 is usually understood.
亻 person + 分 divide: one share for each person.
瓦 on the right means pottery: old bottles were clay.
木 wood on the left: old cups were wooden.
One line.
Two lines. Before a measure word, say 两 instead.
两碗, not 二碗: when counting things, two is 两.
Three lines.
Two strokes spreading apart. A lucky number: it sounds like 发 (get rich).
A cross: 十五 = ten-five = 15, 二十 = two-ten = 20.
一百二十 = one-hundred two-ten = 120.
Fills a gap: 一百零五 = 105.
亻 person on the left.
你 with 心 heart underneath: 'you' said with respect.
我要 = I want. The most useful word in any shop.
来一碗 = 'bring a bowl': the casual way to order.
没 negates 有. Use 没 (not 不) with 有.
口 mouth + 马 horse (for the sound): a spoken question mark. Add it to any sentence to make a yes/no question.
没有了 = 'there is none any more': 了 marks that something changed.
The general 'not'. 不要 = don't want.
不辣的 = the not-spicy one. 的 turns a description into a thing.
微辣 = slightly spicy. Same 微 as in 微信 (WeChat, 'micro message').
打 do + 包 wrap: 'do the wrapping'.
Something under a roof, so 'at / in'.
这 this + 儿 (Beijing-style ending): 'this spot'.
口 mouth on the left.
多 many + 少 few: 'many-few?' = how much?
钅 metal on the left: money used to be metal coins.
Literally 'a lump': 十块 = 10 yuan. Spoken form of 元.
讠 speech on the left.
不 not + 客气 polite: 'no need to be polite'.
好 = 女 woman + 子 child: something good.
讠 speech on the left: a polite word.
慢 slow + 用 use: 'take your time'. 请慢用 is what staff say when serving.

en: boss (how you call the shop owner)
why: Customers call any shop owner 老板 to get attention.
问 = a 口 mouth inside a 门 door: someone at the door asking.
麻烦 = trouble: 'I'm troubling you'. A polite start to a request.
还有吗 = is there still some?
纟 silk on the left: giving a gift of silk.
A 还是 B? = A or B? Only for questions.
扫 sweep + 码 code: you sweep your phone over the code.
现 present + 金 gold: money right here.
一 one + 共 together: all together.
Softens a sentence: 我扫码吧 = I'll scan, OK?
算 count + 了: 'it's counted, done'. Signals a change of mind.
再来一个 = bring one more. Not the same zài as 在.
讠 speech on the left.
口 mouth on the left: the sound you listen to.
听 listen + 到 arrive: the sound arrived.
亻 person on the left: a person making something.
上 up + 菜 dish: bring the dish up to the table.
后 = after. 先 A，然后 B = first A, then B.
如果 opens a condition; 就 brings the result.
The result follows at once: 如果下雨，就不去 = if it rains, (then) I won't go.
不 not + 然 so: 'if not so'.
收 receive + 钱 money.
